messages:
Alex Chen: Anyone else seeing increased east-west latency on GPU nodes in us-west-2? Replica pods in gpu-pool-az1 are timing out on inter-pod gRPC calls, started ~11:02 UTC.
Maria Gomez: Yep — CI jobs failing around the same time. I see lots of TCP retransmits and some MTU mismatch logs (9000 vs 1500). Did we roll any network policies?
Kenji Watanabe: Checking... `kubectl get netpol -n gpu-pool-az1` shows a recently applied policy from automation called `deny-egress-from-unlabeled`. It looks like it enforces egress only to pods with a label.
Kenji Watanabe: ```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-from-unlabeled
  namespace: gpu-pool-az1
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      restrict-eastwest: "true"
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector: {}
```
Jordan Patel: Wait that podSelector on the policy means only pods with `restrict-eastwest: "true"` can initiate egress to other pods. Our gpu daemonset and some worker pods don't have that label. That would block normal east-west traffic (gRPC, RDMA).
Ana (ops): If that's true it would explain the failures. Can we patch the policy to allow namespaceSelector or add a permissive egress rule while we fix labels?
Kenji Watanabe: Quick mitigation options: 1) add namespaceSelector: matchLabels: role: gpu 2) add explicit egress ports for grpc/rdma 3) label the daemonset/pods. Patching the policy live is lower blast radius if we add a single allow rule for known podSelector/ports.
Maria Gomez: I can try labeling the daemonset as fastest mitigation. But the MTU/RDMA flakiness might be separate — I still see some RDMA errors after traffic resumes.
Alex Chen: We spun up a new nodepool yesterday with a different AMI; I suspect jumbo frames (MTU 9000) weren't configured on that image. That plus netpol mislabeling would produce exactly these symptoms.
Jordan Patel: I'll add the label to the daemonset now: `kubectl label ds/gpu-driver restrict-eastwest=true -n gpu-pool-az1` and watch.
Kenji Watanabe: Also pushing a small patch to the netpol to explicitly allow TCP 50051 and RDMA range 20079-20087 while we sort AMI configs: `kubectl patch netpol deny-egress-from-unlabeled -n gpu-pool-az1 --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/egress/0/ports","value":[{"protocol":"TCP","port":50051}]}]'` (example)
Maria Gomez: After labeling and the quick patch, gRPC latency dropped back to normal and CI started passing again. RDMA still had intermittent failures — infra ticket queued for AMI/nodepool config.
Ana (ops): I'll open infra ticket and tag the nodepool owners to ensure jumbo frames are configured before scaling.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-78 — netpolicy mislabeling + new nodepool MTU mismatch caused east-west RDMA/gRPC failures. Pager escalated to infra and networking.
Jordan Patel: Temporary mitigation applied (labels + small netpol allow). Will coordinate rollback after AMI fix. Please add any replay steps to the incident.
Kenji Watanabe: Follow-up action: automation should not apply deny-everything netpols without a staging/label propagation check. Filing PR to add label-check gate. :eyes:
Maria Gomez: Thanks everyone. Leaving the temporary allows in place until infra confirms nodepool AMI update. :thumbsup:
